sources.entry: HeyForm - Form builder that allows anyone to create engaging conversational forms for surveys, questionnaires, quizzes, and polls. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: HeyForm is an open-source form builder for creating conversational forms used as surveys, questionnaires, quizzes, and polls.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes HeyForm as a builder for conversational forms that collect information or feedback through surveys, quizzes, and polls. It lists input types including text, email, phone number, picture choice, date picker, and file upload. It supports conditional logic and URL redirections, plus integrations with webhooks, analytics, marketing platforms, Zapier, and Make.com. Themes can be customized with fonts, colors, backgrounds, and custom CSS. Analytics include drop-off and completion rates, and results can be exported to CSV. The repository is a monorepo with packages for a Node server, a React webapp, a form renderer, an embed library, and shared utilities.
use_cases: Build customer surveys or feedback forms
Create quizzes and polls with conditional logic
Collect leads through branded conversational forms
Export form responses to CSV for analysis
Connect form submissions to Zapier or Make.com workflows
Track form drop-off and completion rates
